title: Payment Amounts and Contract Terms
summary: The topic centers on payment handling, higher monthly costs, and contract-period terms, but all sampled reviews are undetermined in sentiment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention a delayed payment transfer causing double payment, a higher monthly payment that felt hard to justify, and differing one-off versus annual contract arrangements.

limitations: All sampled reviews are undetermined in sentiment, so no sentiment-specific conclusions can be drawn.
The examples are few and cover somewhat different subjects, including payment transfer issues, perceived payment value, and contract structure.
The sample is stratified and not representative of the full review population.
